verdict.rationale: Solid's own README lists 'Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere,' a direct first-party claim of the capability. It is only a single feature-list line, with no API detail, example renderer, or target platforms described. Missing for 10: documentation of the custom renderer API, examples of non-DOM targets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write custom renderers so the framework's component model can target platforms other than the browser DOM

citations.quote: Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere
